title: Bank Top-Up Hold for Newer Pocketwire Personal Accounts
content:
The bank top-up hold on the available transfer amount of a Pocketwire Personal Account reads the customer-requested top-ups from a linked bank dated in the last month (automatic funding pulls behind a payment are not top-ups the customer requested) and the account's age in calendar days from its opened date: for an account younger than 180 days, 100 percent of those top-ups is held; for an account at least 180 but younger than 365 days, 50 percent is held; for an older account nothing is held; the held amount is rounded to the cent (half up).

**Which top-ups are read?** Only top-ups the customer requested from a linked bank, dated in the last month — that is, dated later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date. An automatic funding pull from the linked bank behind a payment is not counted, and a top-up from a linked debit card is not a top-up from a linked bank.

**How is the account's age measured?** As the number of calendar days from the opened date to the handling date.

**How much is held at each age?**

| Account age (calendar days) | Held from the last month's requested bank top-ups |
|---|---|
| Up to 179 | 100 percent |
| 180 to 364 | 50 percent |
| 365 or more | Nothing |

**What happens at the edges?** With requested bank top-ups of 600.00 in the last month (hypothetical), 600.00 is held at an age of 179 days, 300.00 at 180 days and at 364 days, and nothing at 365 days.

**Is the held amount rounded?** Yes, to the cent, half up: 50 percent of a hypothetical 125.25 is 62.625, held as 62.63.
